notes: Canonical NSG catalog. scripts/nsg_catalog.py downloads the whole repository at `ref` (a commit SHA on main, not a branch) into cacheDir/<ref>/ and reads its v2 catalog; the pack/{code}.json export is not read. To bump: run `nsg_catalog.py check`, set `ref` to the reviewed SHA, clear tmp/nsg-catalog/, then re-run `nsg_catalog.py fetch <pack>` and the generators in scripts/generate/. Effect IR remains hand-authored in this repo.
